48 engagements

Industrial and energy projects are structured around what lenders test: feasibility, engineering partners and offtake.

Industrial, manufacturing and energy account for 48 of the 650+ engagements in HAYKALAH’s archive census, 2004–2026. The work follows HAYKALAH’s industrial feasibility and project-finance pack: project finance, engineering partners and offtake. The record includes a refinery project in Malaysia, where HAYKALAH was lead financial adviser, and a consortium for smart industrial cities that is now in formation.

Archive census counts are indicative.

What we do

  • Industrial feasibility studies and market research.

  • Project-finance models and bank processes.

  • Coordination of engineering and construction partners.

  • Offtake and sponsor-equity structures.

  • PPP consortium architecture under the PSP Law, with a permanent DevCo and a ProjectCo for each tender.

  • Localization structures for foreign manufacturers entering the Kingdom.

How we create value

  • 01

    Innovation

    For smart industrial cities, HAYKALAH designed a five-party consortium with a permanent DevCo and a ProjectCo for each tender under the PSP Law (in formation, 2026).

  • 03

    Optimization

    For a 150,000-barrel-a-day refinery project in Malaysia, HAYKALAH’s market research and feasibility study tested the project with its Korean engineering and construction partners (2009–11).

Questions

What does an industrial project-finance pack contain?

The feasibility study, the financial model, the engineering and construction partners and the offtake arrangements that lenders review before they commit.

What is offtake?

A contract under which a buyer agrees to purchase part of a project’s future output. It gives lenders visibility of the project’s revenue.

Can one consortium bid for several PPP tenders?

Yes. A permanent development company holds the origination, studies and know-how, and a separate project company is formed for each tender. The lead member of each project company can change to suit the tender.

Tell us about the plant, the program or the market you want to enter. We can start under an NDA.
